messages:
dana (docs): Quick reminder: public notice for the Python compatibility shim goes live in 48h. Migration kit (codemod + CLI) is in staging. Please scan docs for samples that rely on implicit arg coercion.

owen (sdk): Codemod cmd: `redwood-codemod run --repo path --report out.json`. CLI also supports `--autofix` but it's opt-in. We published a short patterns doc listing top 6 break types.

maya (devex): I'll host two office hours tomorrow (9am & 4pm PT). Will record and drop links in #general. Also running the codemod across sample repos and opening PRs for trivial fixes.

li (product): Timeline recap: announcement -> 90 days deprecation -> 30-day final notice. Dedicated customers can request a one-time 90-day extension via support form. Add extension link to public FAQ.

sam (support): Noted. Preparing canned responses and a recovery runbook for callers who see TypeErrors after upgrade.

policy-bot: Telemetry reminder: codemod and CLI collect anonymized counts and stack fingerprints by default. To opt out set `REDWOOD_MIGRATE_TELEMETRY=0`. See privacy blurb in staging guide.

ci-bot: docs staging build passed (sha: b7c9d2). Preview: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/2165432100

dana (docs): Final ask: reviewers please skim samples that show `client.generate(prompt=...)` patterns. If you find implicit uses, flag or fix. We'll publish at 10am PT in two days unless blockers. :thumbsup:

owen (sdk): Ack. I'll push a short PR with before/after snippets for the top 5 patterns today.

maya (devex): Will add calendar invites and the office hours recording link in #general once live.

dana (docs): Thanks team — let's keep the migration friction low.
